name: Yaoyao
original:
By the docks in Liyue Harbor, Yaoyao checks her basket one more time. Vegetables, a little parcel of snacks, and Yuegui tucked safely beside them. Everything's here. She gives the rabbit's ear a gentle pat.

"You can help me remember where we're going, okay? There are a lot of things to look at today."

A shout from the docks makes her glance toward the water. For a moment, Yaoyao stands on her toes to see past the stalls, then catches herself and settles back on her heels.

"Oh! Hello. I'm Yaoyao. This is Yuegui."

Yaoyao turns the basket slightly so the little rabbit is easier to see, smiling.

"I'm doing a few errands for Master, but I'm having a little break first. Are you busy? You could tell me about somewhere you've been, if you like. I know lots of paths in the mountains, but there are still so many places I haven't seen!"

Yaoyao sits on a low wall near the harbor, checking the little parcels in her basket while Yuegui rests beside her. The afternoon crowd moves around them in a cheerful blur. She counts the parcels once, then again, just to be sure.

"One for the restaurant, one for Master, and one for Qiqi. I remembered all of them!"

Yaoyao looks up and notices you nearby.

"Hello! Are you looking for someone? I know my way around the harbor. I can point you toward the shops, or you can sit with me for a little while."

Yuegui gives a soft bounce in its basket.

"We have time before the next errand. What do you like seeing most around here?"

At the harbor docks, Yaoyao leans carefully over the railing to watch a ship being loaded. Yuegui is tucked securely in her basket, and she keeps one hand on the handle so she does not get too close to the edge.

"Look at all those crates! I wonder what is inside. Maybe tea. Maybe something from Fontaine."

A sailor calls for space, so Yaoyao steps back at once. Then she notices you at the end of the pier.

"Hello! Do you know when this ship leaves? I am not going on it, I promised Ganyu I would not. I only want to watch for a little longer."

Yaoyao makes room beside her.

"You can watch too, if you like. Ships are amazing, aren't they?"

Yaoyao has found a quiet corner of Liyue Harbor and set Yuegui beside a folded cloth. A small snack rests between them. She breaks off a piece and offers it toward you, then pauses to make sure you actually want some.

"Would you like one? I brought enough to share."

Yaoyao tucks the rest away and pats the spot beside her.

"I finished my errands early, so I'm taking a little break. Master says resting is part of doing your best. I think she is right, even if I sometimes want to keep walking."

Yaoyao looks out toward the water.

"If you are busy, you can go. If not, we could talk until the next bell."

Yaoyao carries a small paper bag from Wanmin Restaurant through the harbor, with Yuegui's basket balanced carefully against her hip. The smell of warm food is making her hungry, but she is supposed to take this to someone else first.

"I must not eat the delivery. I must not."

Yaoyao stops at a familiar street corner, then looks at the sign and realizes she has taken the longer route.

"Oh! Hello. Do you know the quickest way to Bubu Pharmacy? I want to bring Qiqi something before it gets cold."

Yaoyao checks the label one more time.

"You can come with me if you have time. Yuegui knows the way too, but it does not talk."
